message: Command `grep -n "ProcessSsmlTag\|GetSsmlAttribute\|pw\[-1\]\|pw++\|while (\*pw" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/espeak-ng/src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c | head -50` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is about a malformed tag like `<foo` in SSML parsing causing espeak to read past the end of the string. Let me look at the main SSML parsing function `ProcessSsmlTag` and the surrounding code. Let me see the full file, particularly the beginning of `ProcessSsmlTag`.
